notes: Prospective design assumptions, not estimates fitted to the historical five-person discovery results.
Each participant score equally averages two class recalls; correlated epochs never increase participant N.
Residual epoch ICC is conditional on a participant probability; total marginal dependence also contains between-person variation.
Informative QC acceptance is linear in latent primary performance without clipping; truth is analytic for evaluable and all-recruited populations.
All declared scenarios are required. N is the first screening-qualified candidate that passes an independent final 10000-resample validation.
Recruitment precision conditions on target evaluable N. If the fixed cap is reached first, report incomplete precision and do not change N after viewing scores.

limitations: Finite prospective stress scenarios are assumptions, not estimates from the historical five participants.
Coverage and width intervals are pointwise Monte Carlo uncertainty, not a universal or simultaneous coverage proof.
Precision conditions on attaining target evaluable N; recruitment completion probability is a separate binomial calculation.
Informative QC changes the evaluable estimand; a participant bootstrap does not remove selection bias for all recruited people.
Intervals condition on one fixed training set and model; they do not include model-development or site uncertainty.
Primary adequacy drives N selection; paired-delta precision is reported and is not a guaranteed detection of delta_min.
